# Owner-only click stats for the last 7 days

> `stats` lets a link's owner read the last 7 days of clicks, summed per minute, from the `ClickHouse` `link_clicks_minute` table.

_Part of [Link click attribution and stats](link-click-analytics.md)_

The owner calls `GET /links/:code/stats` (a logged-in route, guarded by `@Firewall()`). The controller method `stats` passes the short code and the signed-in user's id to `ShareLinkService.stats`. First, `stats` looks the link up with [`resolve`](resolve-pipeline.md). If the link is missing, expired, or belongs to someone else, it throws the same `NotFoundException('Link not found')`. So a stranger can't tell "not yours" from "doesn't exist". If the owner matches, it runs one `ClickHouse` query on `link_clicks_minute`. It filters by the code and the last 7 days, sums `clicks` for each `minute`, and sorts by time. The rows come back as they are, with `minute` and `clicks` as strings. The clicks themselves are written by [Link click attribution and stats](link-click-analytics.md).

**Look at:** [share-link.service.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/application/share-link.service.ts) · [share-links.controller.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/api/share-links.controller.ts)

## Pieces

- Owner check that hides other people's links: Compares the link's `ownerId` with the caller's id and answers 404 for both a missing link and a link owned by someone else.
- [Seven-day per-minute click query](minute-sum-query.md): A `ClickHouse` `SELECT` on `link_clicks_minute` that sums clicks per minute for the code over the last 7 days, oldest first.
- [Look up a code through Bloom filter, cache and DynamoDB](resolve-pipeline.md): The same lookup used by redirects, reused here to find the link and its owner.

## What it touches

| Kind | Name | How |
|---|---|---|
| database | `link_clicks_minute (ClickHouse)` | Read only. Clicks are summed per `minute` for one `code` over the last 7 days. |
| database | `Links (DynamoDB)` | Read through `resolve` to get the link and its `ownerId` for the ownership check. |
| api | `GET /links/:code/stats` | Owner-only endpoint that returns the per-minute click rows. |

## Watch out

- A link you don't own gives the same 404 as one that doesn't exist, on purpose.
- The window is fixed at 7 days and can't be changed by the caller.
- `minute` and `clicks` come back as strings, not numbers.
- Minutes with no clicks are missing from the result, not returned as zero. Nothing in the query fills the gaps.
